info.name: PoultryStock API Tests (Steps 8-10)
info.description: Backend test suite. Before EACH full run: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed. Select the PoultryStock Local environment (needs base_url), then Run collection.

exec: pm.test("5 seeded categories", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(5); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property("products_count"); });

item.name: A06 Delete category that has products (blocked)
A09 Create supplier, bad phone and no name

exec: pm.test("Errors on name and phone", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; pm.expect(e).to.have.property("name"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("phone"); });

item.name: A12 Delete supplier that has products (blocked)

exec: pm.test("10 per page, 25+ total, has category", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.eql(10); pm.expect(j.meta.per_page).to.eql(10); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.at.least(25); pm.expect(j.data[0].category).to.have.property("name"); });
pm.test("6 egg products", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.eql(6); j.data.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.name.toLowerCase()).to.include("egg"); }); });
pm.test("Exactly 1 product", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.data[0].sku).to.eql("FD-BST-001"); });
pm.test("6 products, all category 2", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.eql(6); j.data.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.category_id).to.eql(2); }); });
pm.test("6 low-stock products", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.eql(6); j.data.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.is_low_stock).to.eql(true); }); });

pm.test("Page 2 has 2 rows and links keep low_stock", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.meta.current_page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.links.first).to.include("low_stock=1"); });

item.name: A20 Create product with duplicate SKU
A21 Create product with invalid data

exec: pm.test("Errors on each bad field", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; ["category_id","name","sku","unit","price","reorder_level"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k); }); });

item.name: A24 Product now has 10 in stock
A25 Stock out more than available
A26 Invalid movement type and quantity

exec: pm.test("Errors on type and quantity", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; pm.expect(e).to.have.property("type"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("quantity"); });

item.name: A27 Delete product that has history (blocked)
A29 Delete product with no history

exec: pm.test("Paginated, 290+ total", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.eql(15); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.at.least(290); pm.expect(j.data[0]).to.have.property("product"); });

item.name: S02 Staff cannot create a category
S03 Staff cannot create a supplier
S04 Staff cannot update a product
S05 Staff cannot delete a product

exec: pm.test("Recorded by Ana Mercado", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.name).to.eql("Ana Mercado"); });

item.name: S10 Staff sees only their own movements

exec: pm.test("All rows are Ana Mercado's", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(0); d.forEach(function (m) { pm.expect(m.user.name).to.eql("Ana Mercado"); }); });

item.name: N02 Record movement without a token

exec: pm.test("Paginated with details", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.at.least(8); var o = j.data[0]; pm.expect(o).to.have.property("supplier"); pm.expect(o.items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(o).to.have.property("can"); });
pm.test("Only pending", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.at.least(3); j.data.forEach(function (o) { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("pending"); }); });
pm.test("Only received", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.at.least(2); j.data.forEach(function (o) { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("received"); }); });

pm.test("Pending, total 29750, Ana can edit", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("pending"); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(29750); pm.expect(d.requester.name).to.eql("Ana Mercado"); pm.expect(d.can.edit).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.can.approve).to.eql(false); });

item.name: P09 Duplicate product and bad quantity

exec: pm.test("Item errors reported", function () { var keys = Object.keys(pm.response.json().errors); pm.expect(keys.some(function (k) { return k.indexOf("items.") === 0; })).to.eql(true); });

item.name: P10 Ana edits her own pending order

exec: pm.test("Updated, total 30000", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.notes).to.eql("Edited by Ana"); pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(30000); });

item.name: P11 Ramon cannot edit Ana's order
P12 Ramon cannot delete Ana's order
P14 Cannot receive a pending order

exec: pm.test("Approved by Elena Dizon", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("approved"); pm.expect(d.approver.name).to.eql("Elena Dizon"); });

item.name: P17 Cannot edit an approved order

exec: pm.test("Received by Ana", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("received"); pm.expect(d.receiver.name).to.eql("Ana Mercado"); pm.expect(d.received_at).to.not.eql(null); });

item.name: P21 Stock did NOT increase again
P22 Receiving logged a stock-in movement

exec: pm.test("Movement linked to the order", function () { var m = pm.response.json().data.filter(function (x) { return String(x.purchase_order_id) === String(pm.environment.get("tmp_po_id")); }); pm.expect(m.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(m[0].quantity).to.eql(25); });

item.name: P25 Cannot receive a rejected order
P28 Ramon deletes his own pending order
P30 Cannot delete a received order
P31 Approve an order that does not exist
P32 Purchase orders without a token

exec: pm.test("3+ users, no passwords", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(3); d.forEach(function (u) { pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property("password"); }); });

item.name: U02 Admin creates a staff user
U04 Invalid role and short password

exec: pm.test("Errors on role and password", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; pm.expect(e).to.have.property("role"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("password"); });

item.name: U09 Cannot demote the last admin
U10 Cannot delete a user with history

exec: pm.test("All figures are numbers", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; ["total_products","low_stock_count","pending_orders","approved_orders","inventory_value","movements_this_week"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(d[k]).to.be.a("number"); }); pm.expect(d.total_products).to.be.at.least(25); pm.expect(d.inventory_value).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("Lists are included", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.low_stock_products.length).to.be.at.most(5); pm.expect(d.recent_movements.length).to.be.at.most(5); });
